### Planning Intelligence Log

**Session**: 2026-05-16 → 2026-05-17, /dso:brainstorm — outcome of d076 post-mortem session.

**Convergence path**: 5 brainstorm spec iterations (v1 → v2 → v3.1 → v3.2 → v3.3 → v3.4 → v3.5 → v4 → v5). The v4 → v5 transition was a methodological restructure responding to the bot-psychologist's diagnosis that "the patching method itself" was the root cause of recursive 'fix-introduces-pattern' findings. v4 introduced primitive-first organization (5 Primitives + 4 Cross-Primitive Invariants); v5 closed the residual cross-Primitive tensions with surgical edits. Bot-psych declared v5 READY for brainstorm:complete.

**Reviewer outcomes (v5 final)**:
- Agent Clarity: 5/5 PASS, zero findings
- Scope: 5/5/5/5 PASS, zero findings (right_sized rose from 4 → 5 with the primitive-first restructure)
- Value: 5/5 PASS, zero findings
- Feasibility: 5/4 PASS (single info finding on parity-test CI surface noted as design intent)
- Red Team v5: 17 findings → Blue Team filtered → 16 surviving residuals (all medium-tier specification gaps suitable for preplanning-stage story-DD elaboration); zero critical at Primitive/SI layer
- Bot-Psychologist v5: 0 critical, 2 minor — READY verdict

**Cross-epic interaction scan (Step 2.25)**: Dispatched 29 haiku-batches of 5 epics each against all 144 open/in-progress epics. 70 signals returned: 47 considerations (deduped + injected as Cross-Epic Interactions ACs), 18 ambiguity+conflict halt-candidates (override-approved by user per Step 2.27; sequencing coordination noted for the two real conflicts: b575-ac1c arbiter rewrite + cfb3-3f53 end-session compaction).

**Retrospective audit (post-mortem driven)**: Dispatched 8 opus-tier sub-agents auditing all 39 brainstorm-complete epics against the 6 amendment probes (self-use, workflow-trigger audit, state-lifecycle contract, bypass governance, spec-phase coverage, external-outcome capture). 28 of 39 (72%) flagged HIGH severity; 6 MEDIUM; 5 NONE. Audit doc shipped to docs/findings/architecture-vs-evidence-audit-2026-05-16.md + JSON sidecar at commit 5dc5cbb562 (merged via PR #181 as 2e402afcb6 on 2026-05-17). 33 of 34 impacted epics tagged arch-evidence:remediation-needed (one bridge-ID caveat: w21-bsnz documented).

**Skill shipped**: /dso:remediate-arch-evidence (single-epic remediation skill at plugins/dso/skills/remediate-arch-evidence/SKILL.md) committed at 5dc5cbb562, merged to origin/main, plugin version bumped 1.17.9 → 1.17.10 — invocable in fresh sessions after /reload-plugins. Referenced by SC10 as retrospective evidence.

**Self-validation note (bootstrap paradox)**: This epic's mechanism (verifier verdict categorization + Phase I narrative faithfulness + brainstorm probes + spec-vs-DD fidelity) is designed to prevent f61f-class and b575-class failures. The bot-psychologist's repeated "fix re-introduces pattern" findings during v2-v3.5 iterations are themselves an empirical demonstration of the failure mode this epic addresses at the spec layer. The v4 primitive-first restructure and v5 surgical edits constitute self-application of the discipline this epic codifies. Limitation acknowledged in SC8: same-mechanism agreement demonstrates consistency, not correctness.

**Web research**: 7 research targets surveyed (CI/CD systems, workflow orchestration tools, issue-tracker successor patterns, postmortem structured templates, code-review override discipline, verdict-as-structured-data, LLM-orchestration motivated-reasoning literature). Six of seven converged on typed-enum + prose-message dual-channel pattern (Tekton, SARIF, Prefect, in-toto/SLSA, GitHub branch protection, Gerrit). LLM motivated-reasoning literature (arxiv 2510.17057) explicitly contradicted the regex-over-prose approach (Approach C). Convergence supported Approach D (full structured schema + template-driven narrative), the basis of v5.

**Approach decision**: User selected Approach D + 4-value SARIF-style enum (`architecture_complete_evidence_pending | architecture_incomplete | external_blocker | not_applicable`) per the web-research convergence. The Approach A/C alternatives were rejected for motivated-reasoning vulnerability; Approach E rejected on G7 attention-conservation; D-staged (red-team's tripwire variant) rejected on schedule preference.

**Scope decisions**: Tight scope (21 in-scope bugs) confirmed early; 70fe-1c39 absorbed mid-brainstorm when chronic-feature-flag principle was articulated (final 22 in-scope bugs). End-session demoted to fallback-only per user directive (long-running orchestration workflows lose end-session reliability through compactions). Plugin-agnostic constraint enforced throughout.

**Practitioner-requested additional cycles**: 5 iterative re-runs of the scrutiny pipeline (v3.1 → v3.2 → v3.3 → v3.4 → v3.5) plus the v4 primitive-first restructure (responding to bot-psych methodological diagnosis) plus the v5 final convergence pass.

**LLM-instruction signal (Step 5)**: triggered — the epic modifies multiple skill files (brainstorm, preplanning, implementation-plan, sprint Phase E/F/I, debug-everything closure, completion-verifier agent). Bot-psychologist dispatched across all 5 iterations; final v5 verdict: READY.

**Scale context**: not applicable (planning-pipeline + closure-verification mechanism epic; no volume/throughput decision).

**Cross-epic dispatch quality**: 5 of 29 batches degraded due to haiku context-window pressure on epic descriptions; bug 4bf1-3198 already filed for batch-size tuning. Did not affect the load-bearing signals (the two real conflicts on b575-ac1c + cfb3-3f53 were captured in clean batches).
